title: A compactly supported cut-off of the pull-back of a smooth form by a smooth map is a test form
statement: Let P, Q, k ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q a C^∞ map, χ : ℝ^P → ℝ a C^∞ function with compact support, and ω a C^∞ k-form on ℝ^Q (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k). Then there is η ∈ D^k(ℝ^P) = TestFormOn univ k with η(y) = χ(y) · (ω(f(y))).compContinuousLinearMap (Df(y)) for every y ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (χ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ω → ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k, ∀ y, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) y = χ y • (ω (f y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f y)
